notes: Adds encrypted Google Calendar integration with reviewed appointment creation, approaching-meeting alerts, and scheduled calendar/weather/news briefings that never replay after downtime. Adds one room-aware player for Spotify Premium/Connect, YouTube, and securely indexed local music, with explicit destination mappings, queues, favorites, playlists, volume controls, restart/ownership fencing, and Windows-native reparse-safe file access. Adds validated user routines and disabled-until-configured starter scenes using only allowlisted Chat actions, optional no-replay schedules, generation-fenced execution, and sanitized history. Source upgrades now install newly declared Python dependencies before replacing code, including a safe bridge for upgrades from 1.9.23.
